title: Tribal Movements Singphos Rebellion
definition: The Singphos Rebellion refers to the series of armed uprisings by the Singpho tribe of Assam and Arunachal Pradesh against British colonial expansion and administrative encroachment in the early 19th century.
importanceInUpsc: Essential for understanding the 'Resistance to British Rule' module in Modern Indian History, specifically the tribal resistance in the North-East frontier region.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Tribal Movements Singphos Rebellion.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
